header.title: Import / Export Excel
header.description: Bring plans from Excel into Friday Manage and track where the plan changed compared with the original plan (Baseline)

import.drop: Drag a .xlsx file here, or choose a file
import.dropHint: .xlsx only · The Tasks sheet must have Module and Title headers in the first row (older plan files with No. still work)
import.jobMetaChecklist: Sheet {sheet} · {rows, plural, one {{rows} task} other {{rows} tasks}} · {checklist, plural, one {{checklist} checklist item} other {{checklist} checklist items}} · Uploaded
import.modeCreateHint: Creates every Module and task from the file
import.modeUpdateHint: Matches tasks by the Key column (older files use No.) · Rows with changed values are recorded as "Plan changes"
import.noBaselinePerm: You don't have permission to update this project's plan (requires permission to set a Baseline)
import.kind__replaceHint: Match tasks by Key (No. for the legacy format) and update them from the file · choose whether tasks missing from the file are deleted or kept
import.kind__appendHint: Every row becomes a new task after the current plan · existing tasks are not changed or deleted · for a second plan such as a new module
import.kind__unstarted: Update only work not started yet
import.kind__unstartedHint: Match by Key / No. and update only To do tasks that haven't started (overdue ones too) · started work is left alone · nothing is deleted · new tasks in the file are added only after you confirm
import.diffHint__locked: Tasks whose values differ from the file but have already started, so they are not updated
import.diffHint__addedAsk: Tasks in the file that aren't in the project yet · added only when you confirm
import.addNew: Add {count, plural, one {{count} new task} other {{count} new tasks}} to the plan
import.addNewHint: Leave unticked to update only existing tasks that haven't started, without creating tasks or sub-tasks
import.sumLocked: {count, plural, one {{count} started task} other {{count} started tasks}} left as is
import.sumNotAdded: {count, plural, one {{count} new task} other {{count} new tasks}} in the file not confirmed and won't be added
import.noProjects: No projects you can update yet
import.mapTitle: Map Excel columns to Friday Manage fields
import.colSample: Sample value from the first row
import.ruleStatus: Status: Not Start → To do · In Progress → In progress · Done → Done
import.ruleSize: Size: XS 1 · S 3 · M 5 · L 8 · XL 12 Man-Days
import.ruleDevs: Multiple Devs: Man-Days belong to the whole team and are split equally in Workload
import.chipReady: {count, plural, one {{count} row ready} other {{count} rows ready}}
import.reupload: Fix in Excel and upload again
import.noFindings: No issues found. Every row is ready to import
import.readyMore: {count, plural, one {and {count} more row ready to import} other {and {count} more rows ready to import}}
import.diffSummary: Changed {changed} · Added {added} · Missing from file {missing} · Unchanged {unchanged}
import.diffHint__missing: Tasks in the project that are not in the file · keep or delete each one, or choose for all above
import.diffHint__changed: Existing tasks whose values differ from the file · old value → new value
import.diffHint__added: Tasks that will be created, grouped by module · click a module to see its tasks
import.missingAll: All tasks missing from the file
import.projectKeyHint: 2–10 uppercase English letters, used for task numbers such as DP-39
import.sumSprint: 2-week Sprints for the whole project. You can set them separately later on the Backlog page
import.sumRows: {ready} scheduled tasks + {backlog} tasks to Backlog (skipping {skipped} rows that still need fixing)
import.sumDates: Plan Start / Plan End from the file · Working days follow the Workspace calendar + Holidays sheet
import.sumChanged: Change {changed} tasks · Add {added} tasks (skipping {skipped} rows that still need fixing)
import.sumMissing: {missing} tasks missing from file: delete {deleted} · keep {kept}
import.sumPlanChange: Changes to Plan Start / Plan End / Man-Day / Dev are recorded in the "Plan changes" tab
import.people: Match people in the file to members
import.peopleHint: People who aren't members yet will receive an invitation
import.baseline: Set this plan as Baseline v1
import.baselineHint: Used to compare Plan vs Actual in the Gantt, and every later plan change is recorded in the "Plan changes" tab
import.reasonHint: Recorded in the Plan changes tab · Leave blank = "Update plan from file {file}"
import.commitCreate: Import {count, plural, one {{count} task} other {{count} tasks}}
import.commitUpdate: Update {count, plural, one {{count} task} other {{count} tasks}}
import.undecided: {count, plural, one {{count} person not matched} other {{count} people not matched}} · If not chosen, tasks are imported without a person
import.doneCreate: Created project {name} · {imported} tasks (scheduled {scheduled} · Backlog {backlog}) · Skipped {skipped} rows
import.doneUpdate: Updated {name} · Changed {changed} · Added {added} · Deleted {deleted} · Recorded {planChanges} plan changes
import.doneChecklist: Added {count, plural, one {{count} checklist item} other {{count} checklist items}}
import.doneInvites: Sent {count, plural, one {{count} invitation} other {{count} invitations}}
import.templateHint: Start from the template: same columns as the export, with instructions, allowed values and a Holidays sheet
import.sectionNote: Exports use the template columns · edit outside, then import back to update the plan · importing and plan changes need the baseline permission

changes.counts: {issues} tasks changed · End dates affected in {modules} Module
changes.modulesTitle: End date of each Module: plan vs forecast
changes.early: {days, plural, one {{days} day earlier} other {{days} days earlier}}
changes.noModules: No tasks in this Baseline yet
changes.footer: Every change to Plan Start / Man-Day / Plan End / Dev is recorded automatically · Changes after a Baseline require a reason · Actual Start / End are recorded when a task moves to In progress / Done
changes.emptyHint: Changes to Plan Start / Plan End / Man-Day / Dev after a Baseline is set appear here
changes.noBaselineHint: Set the current plan as a Baseline first, then every later plan change is recorded for comparison
changes.dialogTitle: Set current plan as Baseline v{version}
changes.dialogBody: Saves the current Plan Start / Plan End / Man-Day / Dev of every task for comparison · Later plan changes are compared with the new Baseline

export.title: Export current plan + Timeline
export.description: An .xlsx of today's data with the template columns, plus a Timeline (Gantt) sheet to share or plan outside
export.sheetHint__tasks: All tasks and sub-tasks with the template columns; can be imported back
export.sheetHint__timeline: A plan bar per task, coloured by status, red when overdue, with a today line
export.sheetHint__values: Status, Priority, Size, Module and members to pick in cells
export.noPermission: You can't export this project's plan

create.title: Create a project from Excel
create.description: Upload a plan (.xlsx) and the system creates modules and tasks from the file, with Baseline v1
